materialization.notes: Materialized 175 variables across two modes (dark, light) via the repo-owned plugin's upsert rail, fetching the artifact over the local token server (pnpm figma:tokens:serve, localhost:4173). Count moved 176 -> 174 -> 175 across two publishes and one scripted deletion. First publish (fb4e7e4) was a pure re-value with no ID change: interaction/focus-ring moved off core/color/blue/600 to a themed neutral, #9ca2af dark / #535966 light, because blue-600 measured 2.74 on background/elevated and 2.52 on background/overlay in dark and so could not serve as a focus ring on the surfaces dialogs and menus use. That token gained its first per-mode value, so light-mode was a new entry rather than an edit. Then semantic/color/interaction/selection and core/color/blue-alpha/30 were REMOVED with figma-use (176 -> 174), because the plugin is upsert-only and cannot delete; ::selection is now computed in the role bridge as color-mix over --primary so it follows a user-set accent, which a baked rgba could not (CHANGE_POLICY removal, commit ceddc2f). A whole-document scan across both pages confirmed zero node bindings, zero other-variable aliases, and zero dangling references before the deletion, and the Foundations page was regenerated first so no binding was left pointing at a removed variable. Second publish added shape/role/selection = 0.3 (174 -> 175), the ratio the role bridge multiplies. Post-sync verification: Figma's 175 variable names reconcile EXACTLY against the artifact's 175 published leaves, no extras on either side. Foundations page regenerated: 561 bound paints, 0 unbound, 0 dead references, 10 effects, 6 frames.
